settings.title: Settings

mcp.title: MCP Servers
mcp.description: MCP (Model Context Protocol) lets AI call external tools and services. Add an MCP server here, then connect it when you want its tools to become available.
mcp.confirmDelete: Delete MCP server "{{name}}"? Connected tools will be disconnected first.

form.name: Server Name
form.nameDesc: A unique identifier for this MCP server. Use letters, numbers, or underscores.
form.nameNoSpaces: Server names cannot contain spaces. Use underscores instead.
form.endpointDescStdio: For stdio servers, enter the executable command path.
form.endpointDescHttp: For http / sse servers, enter the server URL.
form.envVarsDesc: One per line in KEY=VALUE format.

list.emptyHint: Click "Add Server" to configure your first MCP server.

skills.description: Install and manage custom skill packs. Restart required after changes.
skills.emptyHint: Click "Install Skill" to add custom skill packs
skills.marketplaceDesc: Browse and install community skill packs
skills.loginRequired: Sign in to browse the skill marketplace

general.workspaceHint: If you want AI to read a local folder directly, use the paperclip in the chat input and choose "Connect local directory (no copy)".

knowledge.label: Knowledge sources
knowledge.hint: Upload FAQ / product manual / tech docs. After hiring, files are sliced into memory in the background; the AI retrieves on demand via semantic search instead of stuffing the full text each turn.

groupMatch.label: Monitor groups (keyword matching)
groupMatch.includeHintSimple: Group names containing any keyword will be matched. New groups matching these keywords are auto-included on next scan.

escalation.label: Escalation keywords (skip auto-reply, flag for human handling)
escalation.hint: Messages containing these words will be flagged 🔴 for manual handling.

techKeywords.label: Tech keywords (route to tech support)
techKeywords.hint: Messages containing these words will be tagged 🔧 for tech support.

customerSupport.title: Customer support setup
customerSupport.intro: The employee scans matching DingTalk groups for business inquiries, searches the knowledge base + past conversations, then drafts friendly replies for your review.

techSupport.title: Tech support setup
techSupport.intro: The employee scans matching DingTalk groups for errors and integration questions, searches tech docs + past experience, then drafts replies for your review.

monitoringUrls.title: Monitoring targets
monitoringUrls.label: Monitor URLs
monitoringUrls.hint: The researcher will periodically visit these URLs to detect changes.

salesTable.title: Data source
salesTable.intro: Paste a DingTalk AI Table link. XiaoXiao reads active deals from this table. You can leave the field mapping blank — the employee will guide you through it the first time a task is assigned.
salesTable.parseError: Link format not recognized. Fill in baseId / tableId manually below, or save now — XiaoXiao will guide you to locate the table when the first task is assigned.
salesTable.fieldMappingHint: Leave blank — on the first task the employee will call dws to list real field names for you.
salesTable.fieldMappingError_object: Must be a JSON object ({}) — not an array or null
salesTable.fieldMappingError_string: Column name for field {{field}} must be a string

weeklyReport.title: Weekly report preferences
weeklyReport.intro: Configure your weekly report. XiaoZhou auto-summarises DingTalk calendar, todos, and group chats every Friday, then surfaces a structured draft for you to review and edit.
weeklyReport.templateStandardDesc: Schedule + todos + chats, grouped by day
weeklyReport.templateOkrDesc: This week's progress mapped to O/KRs
weeklyReport.watchGroupsPlaceholder: e.g. Product weekly, Engineering daily, Customer support
weeklyReport.watchGroupsHintSimple: Enter DingTalk group names, separated by commas (English or Chinese) or newlines. XiaoZhou searches by name and extracts key discussions for the week. Leave blank to skip chat summaries.
